title: What a SauSaGe! It's All Meat
statement: Given an array of n values below 16 (n up to 2·10^5) with q point assignments, one operation XORs two adjacent elements with the same value 3k (k from 1 to 5). After each update, the task is to report the maximum number of elements that can be made divisible by 3. The key is the popcount-parity invariant, which reduces each answer to counting even-popcount values.
